decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. The disputed transaction TXN-007871 (68731 EUR cents at LUMEN TRAVEL, MER-000070) is on card CRD-000182. It posted on 2026-10-13 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29. That is 16 days, well within the 120-day time limit. Its authorisation AUTH-008083 is an online payment (entry mode ECOMMERCE). The cardholder confirmed it with 3-D Secure (AUTHENTICATED), the card security code matched (CVV MATCH), the bank approved it and the fraud flag was not set. The policy treats an online payment confirmed with 3-D Secure and without the fraud flag as made by the cardholder, and a matching security code supports this. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: the disputed purchase is the only one. That is context only and does not change the outcome. The cardholder's statement that they never shopped there does not outweigh the authentication record.

proposed_actions.reason: The bank's records show this online payment of 687.31 EUR was confirmed with 3-D Secure, the card's security code was correct and the payment was not flagged as suspicious. Under our policy, that makes it a payment made by the cardholder, so the dispute is declined.
